block.voyager.blockhutvoyager.name: Departure Point
com.voyager.building.voyager.desc: Home of the Voyager, who leaves for the End on expeditions and returns with end stone, purpur, chorus, ender pearls and shulker shells. Build it as a Launchpad with a rocket or as an End Gate - the Voyager structure pack has both.
voyager:voyager.job.desc: Leaves for the End on expeditions and comes back with a haul of End treasures and a story to tell. A very dangerous job - pack armor, a sword, a pickaxe and rations!
voyager:voyager.skills.desc: Adaptability shapes what they find, Agility the odds of coming home unhurt.
Where no colonist has gone before

com.minecolonies.coremod.jei.voyager: Leaves for the End on expeditions and returns with End loot. Every trip costs supplies, and not every Voyager comes home.

block.voyager.blockhutobservatory.name: Observatory
com.voyager.building.observatory.desc: Home of the Astronomer, who works the night while the rest of the colony sleeps and brings back plates of what is up there. Build it as a Copper Dome, a Stargazer's Keep, a Sand Court, a Skyward Station or an Aperture Array - the Voyager structure pack has all five. Needs Exposure and Exposure: Space.
voyager:astronomer.job.desc: Works nights at the Observatory: watches the sky when it is clear and comes home at dawn with a plate. The only colonist in town whose shift is the opposite of everybody else's.
voyager:astronomer.skills.desc: Knowledge decides what they can identify, Focus how long they can hold a night's watch.

block.voyager.blockhutphotobooth.name: Photo Booth
com.voyager.building.photobooth.desc: The colony's studio, darkroom and print shop. The Photographer crafts every camera, film, frame and album the colony needs, develops the film you bring home - and takes photographs: of colonists, of every building the builder finishes (kept in the colony chronicle, an album on the shelf), and from level 2 of visitors, who come in for a portrait and pay for it in Trade Post coins. Build it as a Copper Dome, a Stargazer's Keep, a Sand Court, a Skyward Station or an Aperture Array. Needs Exposure.
com.minecolonies.coremod.jei.photographe: Develops, prints and frames the colony's photographs - and takes a few of their own.
voyager:photographer.job.desc: Runs the colony's studio and darkroom: crafts everything Exposure needs, develops and prints film, photographs the colonists and every new building for the colony chronicle, and takes paid portraits of visitors.
voyager:photographer.skills.desc: Creativity decides what they can be taught, Dexterity how steady the hand is at the enlarger.

com.minecolonies.coremod.setting.tooltip: When there is a hill, ridge or cliff with a clear sky within forty blocks, the astronomer keeps the watch there instead of at the instrument - and brings the colony's camera to photograph the night sky.
Guards from the nearest towers walk out with the astronomer and stand watch at the lookout until the plate is taken.
